description: The one command the person runs on an always-on machine inside their network, next to the database, to connect a private network, and where to download the program it runs (cloudflared). The command carries the network's connector key: give it only to the person or run it only on that machine, and never write it into a chat summary, file, ticket or log. Running it as a service keeps the network connected after a restart. Only owners and admins can read it.

name.description: The network's name: 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting and ending with a letter or digit (office, plant-2). A database connection names it in its Private network setting.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: get_private_network_setup
title: Set up a private network
